# Phosphor icon assets

This directory vendors the **regular** webfont subset from [`@phosphor-icons/web` 2.1.2](https://github.com/phosphor-icons/web/releases/tag/v2.1.2). They are used by the Datum Sync federated worker without a CDN dependency.

The original package is licensed under MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). It retains its upstream CSS glyph map and only its WOFF2 font file.
